description: DB 全体からの値検索 (#748 / #1261) の走査 SQL 生成の実装横断ゴールデンベクタ。移植前の TS 実装 (src/__tests__/oracles/dataSearchOracle.ts) の出力を期待値として固定し、Rust の db::data_search (tests/data_search_golden.rs) と、フロントに残る buildColumnPredicate (dataSearchGolden.test.ts) の両方を同じベクタに通す。`classify` は型名 → CellKind / 走査対象、`predicates` は列ごとの述語、`numericTerms` は数値語判定、`scanSql` はテーブル単位の SUM(CASE) クエリ、`skip` は概算行数のしきい値判定、`parseRow` は結果 1 行 → ヒット件数。新しい境界ケースはここへ追記する。

expected.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `name` LIKE '%ali%' ESCAPE '\\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `name` FROM `shop`.`users`
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `name` LIKE '%42%' ESCAPE '\\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `name`, SUM(CASE WHEN `age` = 42 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `age` FROM `shop`.`users`
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "name" LIKE '%ali%' ESCAPE '\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "name" FROM "users"
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "name" LIKE 'ali%' ESCAPE '\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "name" FROM "public"."users"
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "a""b" = '42' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "a""b", SUM(CASE WHEN "c" = 42 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "c" FROM "public"."we""ird table"
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `a``b` = 'it''s 50%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `a``b` FROM `we``ird db`.`we``ird`
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `name` LIKE '%ali%' ESCAPE '\\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `name` FROM `users`
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `name` LIKE '%ali%' ESCAPE '\\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `name` FROM `users`

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `price` = 1e+21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `price`, SUM(CASE WHEN `d` LIKE '%1e21%' ESCAPE '\\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `d`, SUM(CASE WHEN `e` LIKE '%1e21%' ESCAPE '\\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `e` FROM `shop`.`t`
